quotes.quote: the public repository of CISA's enrichment of public CVE records through CISA's ADP (Authorized Data Publisher) container
First, CISA will take each CVE through an SSVC scoring process.
CISA will determine if there is enough information to assert a specific CWE identifier and/or a CVSS score.
At no point will CISA overwrite the originating CNA's data in the original CNA container in the CVE record.
Every CVE analyzed by the CISA ADP will have three SSVC decision points listed.
For those that aren't, no update will occur.
CISA will no longer be adding CPE strings to the enriched dataset.
the CISA ADP will drop its own assessments from the CVE entry
the originating CNA's data should take precedence
this results in a version number of 2.0.3: SSVC version 2.0, CISA Coordinator tree version 3.
Downstream consumers need not fork and track this GitHub repo if they are already consuming live CVE data.
